args.subject: PHL label cleanup
args.body:
Hi June,

A note on the PHL label confusion:

- "PHL" currently points at two different customers: Pellow Home Living (Mid-Atlantic home goods retailer) and Pellucid Harbor Logistics (Gulf Coast port drayage). Moss's digest says the shorthand shows up in both the retail notes and the port-logistics search results.
- Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows. Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments.
- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 Feb. Older notes still use Covey / CLR / PHL for it.
- Moss's coverage digest (18 May) says a saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals". The old label was making the receiving supervisor search twice, and the label change was added to the handoff list.
- Moss's Coastal cheat sheet still lists the account as "Covey & Lark Retail", so it needs updating too. It already warns to verify the org ID before running bulk seat audits because of the PHL collision.
- Open question: the digest is from 18 May, and we can't see whether the report has been renamed since. Someone should check the saved report.

Ask: rename the saved report to the Pellow Home Living name, and stop using bare "PHL" in reports and notes. Use the full account name or the org ID instead.

Thanks,
Bettina
